area: Area 1: built-in and contrib text search
current_formulation: ts_rank and ts_rank_cd score one document at a time from its own tsvector and use no collection statistics.

steps.formulation: tsearch2 ships the rank functions rank and rank_cd with proximity and structure information.
steps.quote: Sophisticated ranking functions with support of proximity and structure information
PostgreSQL provides two predefined ranking functions, which take into account lexical, proximity, and structural information

criticism.quote: functions do not use any global information, so it is impossible to produce a fair normalization to 1% or 100% as sometimes desired.
